sophie: Main CI went red right after merge of PR #3210 (feat/kv-cache). gpu-smoke failed: `kv_cache_integration_test::smoke_kv_parallel` 3/3. @miguel @raj :eyes:
miguel: On it. Did that PR touch the GPU allocator or just cache logic? I can start looking at logs now.
raj: I can rerun the job. If it's deterministic we should bisect to the merge commit. Who merged this? @elinor?
elinor: I merged it ~10m ago. Only added a small lock around cache invalidation, shouldn't affect allocator directly.
miguel: grabbing logs — seeing OOM in `allocator.cpp:412` during large-batch step, looks like sustained allocation spike.
sophie: Can someone rerun the failing job once? `./scripts/ci rerun --job gpu-smoke --attempt 2`
oncall-bot: Command accepted: rerun queued (job gpu-smoke, attempt 2) — ETA ~6m
miguel: If rerun flakes we should bisect between merge commit and previous. I can run the smoke locally against both.
raj: Rerun started. If it fails again I'm +1 for temporary revert of PR #3210 until investigation completes.
sophie: Quick triage: adding label `investigate/ci-failure` to PR #3210 and pinging owners. @elinor please hold any follow-ups.
elinor: Ack, pausing follow-ups. If revert is needed I'll open it.
oncall-bot: Rerun finished: gpu-smoke still failed (same test).
miguel: Reproduced locally: failing on merge commit, passes on previous commit. Starting bisect locally now.
miguel: Bisect narrowed it to the merge — behavior changes under large batch sizes. Hypothesis: cache invalidation race increases peak allocations.
raj: Thanks. Given impact on main, propose revert PR to restore green. @sophie can you approve an emergency revert?
sophie: Approved. @elinor if you're free can you open the revert PR otherwise I will.
elinor: Opening revert PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/compare/revert-3210 — will request fast-track.
oncall-bot: PR opened: #3225 revert 'feat/kv-cache' — tagging fast-track
sophie: :thumbsup: Thanks all. Keep updates here. Once revert lands let's watch the next main run and then re-run bisect/patch cycle on a branch.
